hashNormalization: UTF-8 source bytes; the publication uses LF line endings and .gitattributes keeps them on every platform.

derivedIdentifierTable.purpose: Local source-generator symbolic-name drift guard, not an upstream publication or NodeId source.
derivedIdentifierTable.derivationResult: All 650 published rows agree with the NodeSet on numeric id and node class; 113 symbolic names follow the generator conventions. No rows are invented.

compatibility: RequiredModel entries are lower bounds: the package loads the DI 1.04, AMB 1.01.1 and Machinery 1.04.1 models the SDK ships. Machinery adds the IA model to the closure.
LADSComponentsType, LADSOperationModeStateMachineType and LADSOperationCountersType derive from Machinery i=1006, i=1008 and i=1009, which keep their NodeIds in Machinery 1.04.1.
MaintenanceTaskType derives from DI MaintenanceRequiredAlarmType and implements AMB IMaintenanceEventType.
